intro: Kazakhstan has about 20 million people from over 100 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: Kazakhs make up about 70%, and Russians are the largest minority. Kazakh and Russian are both widely used, and Kazakh is switching from Cyrillic to Latin letters.
Most Kazakhs are Muslim; most Russians are Orthodox Christian.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Almaty is the biggest city and Astana the capital.
